definitions.short: Galil (as a special circuit) in the North of Palestine
definitions.full: H1551. galil II. גָּלִיל noun masculine cylinder, rod, circuit, district ; — 1 cylinder, rod , only plural construct כֶסֶף גְּלִילֵי Est 1:6 of support of rich hangings (|| שֵׁשׁ עַמּוּדֵי ); & בַּתַּרְשִׁישׁ מְמֻלָּאִים זָהָב גְּלִילֵי Song 5:14 , simile of (? fingers of) hands: cylinders of gold set with topaz. 2 circuit, district , on northern border of Israel in Naphtali (see below), population largely heathen (Late Hebrew id. Aramaic גְּלִילָא , ) — הַגּוֺיִם גְּלִיל Isaiah 8:23; elsewhere = proper name, of a location always with article Josh 20:7 ; 21:32 ; 1Chr 6:61 all בַּגּ ׳קֶדֶשׁ ; הַגּ ׳אֶרֶץ 1Kin 9:11 , so also ᵐ5 Josh 12:23 (compare Di) for גִּלְגַּל q. v.; הַגָּלִ֫ילָה Galilee, 2Kin 15:29 (|| נַפְתָּלִי אֶרֶ֖ ) Ew § 173 h n Sta § 308 a 2 Ges § 90 f .
definitions.rootNote: or (prolonged) גָּלִילָה ; the same as 1550 ; a circle (with the article);
